name: logcadence
description: Read and sort Logcadence's tags and categories, in the running app.
long_description: Talks to Logcadence running on this computer (its local API on 127.0.0.1). Lets Claude list the tags and categories and rename tags. Logcadence must be running. (Videos and AI chats moved to youtube-lib and ai-lib, which have MCP servers of their own.)

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Every tag path, with entry counts.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories entries can be filed under.

tools.name: move_tag
tools.description: Rename a tag path on every entry.
